verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a SaaS meeting-notes product, so the axis applies. Every item in the pack describes a vendor-hosted service: requests run against hosted fellow.app workspaces, and the API and MCP connector sit on top of that cloud product. No evidence shows an on-premises or self-hosted deployment option. Retention policies and data export are adjacent controls and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
